name: record-session-merge-commit
title: record-session derives merge commits the validator refuses
description: derive_work_commits() scans git log with no merge filter, and nothing in its workspace-only filter is about parenthood, so merge commits are derived. On a journal-only planning bundle the final-bundle validator then rejects the cited merge with planning_recovery_commit_non_linear; on a completion bundle, or a planning bundle that also changes a task, that check never runs (:1152-1159) and the journal silently records work against a commit that did not perform it. Reproduced in loadsmith on the PR #208 session.
creator: sdelmas
